title: The Last Contact
author: Freya Nystrom
blurb: Coral Coldharbour, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
